variants.suspected_cause: The assignment expression passed to F_h00_31AA causes a two-byte MOVE.L of its pointer result, while the target pushes the address with a four-byte PEA.
variants.controlled_change: Separate the global pointer assignment from the F_h00_31AA call and pass the same address directly.

predicted_effect.note: The call argument is expected to use PEA.L disp(a4) instead of MOVE.L a0,-(a7), adding two bytes.
